symptom: GitHub Actions research-governance Typecheck on the new finite-mtime schema regression test failed with TS7022 for an inferred schemaRangeAdmits local. Research payload and schema checks were not reached in that job. The failure is test compilation, not a research result or runner/platform failure.
lesson: A synthetic schema parity regression can fail before executing its assertions because the TypeScript checker rejects an inferred local as TS7022. Treat such a red workflow as a test compilation failure, not as evidence about the schema or research payload.
guardrail: When a new synthetic test encounters TS7022 for a simple derived boolean, annotate the local explicitly as boolean and rerun Typecheck plus the full official research-governance and verify jobs. Inspect job logs and separate process exit, workflow conclusion, post-job cleanup and runner evidence; do not retry protected N2 or change production.
